resources.name: Book grammars
resources.title: Feature structures and binding
resources.description: Small grammar files used in the NLTK book. The original local seats.fcfg example exercises shared features; NLTK data is a separate optional download.
resources.license_note: Check each downloaded package's license before redistributing it.

resources.name: WordNet
resources.title: Words, senses, and synonyms
resources.description: Optional exporter produces sense-separated WordNet JSON for human review. WordNet itself is not bundled. No synonym is auto-promoted to an executable alias.
resources.license_note: Retain the license from the exact WordNet corpus you download with any redistributed export.

resources.name: VerbNet
resources.title: Verb frames and semantic roles
resources.description: Research reference only in this version. No VerbNet import or automatic role mapper is installed.
resources.license_note: Check the selected VerbNet package license.
